skills.skill_desc: <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> continuously slows nearby enemies by 20% and reveals their position.

Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at the target location, dealing 75<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.33s and continuously slowing enemies (up to 2.5 times). After 2s, the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> explodes, dealing 260<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 4% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 2.5 times.

<font color="a6aafb">First Cast</font>: Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at a distance and draws it toward her. She gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30%) and can pass through obstacles.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Upon catching the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>, she can cast <font color="a6aafb">Star Shatter</font> to launch it in the target direction within 5s. Upon hitting an enemy hero, it deals 260<font color="62f8fe"> (+95% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to them and nearby heroes. The damage will increase based on the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>'s travel distance (draw + launch), up to 2.2 times the original damage.

Novaria scatters <font color="a6aafb">Astral Echo</font> in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% and applying <font color="a6aafb">Astral Ring</font> on them. This increases their hitbox by 2.5 times and reveals their position for 5s.
